pr.title: Parallel archive downloads
pr.description:
Replaces the sequential downloader with `ParallelDownloader`: 4 worker threads by default, `--workers` from 1 to 16. A full archive run drops from about 40 minutes to 12.

The archive team asked to keep only PDF and ZIP files. Other content types are now skipped with a warning; before, everything was saved. Duplicate URLs in the list download once.

bugs.note: Race: the workers update self.completed outside the lock. A lost update keeps it below the total, so run() waits forever.
Resource leak on an early return: a skipped content type returns before the with block, so the response and its connection stay open.

traps.why: _record changes shared lists without a lock, but its contract says that the caller holds self._lock, and both callers do.
Keeping only PDF and ZIP files is intended. The PR text names the change and who asked for it.
